mocreatures.trigger: Actual tamed Horse.interact with BOOK sent by native client interaction packet
mocreatures.limits: Original MoCGUI uses its own NameToSet string and Done button, not TextFieldWidget; no Ctrl-V behavior is invented for this screen. Native key/char/mouse events, drawing frame, and real save/reopen verified; GPU frames are captured for coordinator inspection.

symptoms: Original Giraffe naming text field returned null before and after native typing.

mocreatures_bunny.exception: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0
mocreatures_bunny.cause: Original loop retains wide query, replaces shared list with narrow query, then reads wide.size() and narrow.get(i). Fresh independent shim lists broke Beta aliasing.

original_api_evidence.untyped_query: fd.b(sn,eq) clears and returns fd.R (per-world List).
original_api_evidence.text_field: ro; original focus, append/backspace, character filter and separate 32-character clipboard cap retained.
original_api_evidence.translation_storage: nh; shared singleton with mod overrides and native language fallback.

policy.render_environment: WSL Ubuntu Xvfb :99, Mesa llvmpipe; no Sodium/Iris

limits: This bounded pass does not establish complete MoCreatures or More Creeps compatibility.
One original More Creeps Giraffe naming screen exercises the TextFieldWidget API shared by five naming screens; all five were not exercised separately.
MoCreatures own MoCGUI uses NameToSet and Done; no new Cancel or paste behavior was invented.
Standard living-renderer hurt/death tint passes remain a source-visible omission; no new live failure is claimed.
Hotdog animated fire sampling, natural breeding/birth and full Werewolf transformation sequences still need end-to-end client checks.
